title: A Darker Shade of Magic
author: V. E. Schwab
summary: There are four Londons in four versions of a world, and only a rare few can travel among them. A magician who smuggles trinkets between them is caught up with a pickpocket who wants to be a pirate, and a dangerous stone.
readIf: you want a quick, stylish fantasy with a charming rogue, parallel worlds and a high-energy plot.
skipIf: you want deep characterisation or a very gentle read, as it is brisk and fairly bloody.

pairings.reason: Another fast, swaggering fantasy with a clever crew and a plan that goes wrong.
Another fantasy beneath and beside a very different version of London, stranger and more whimsical.
A slower, more witty and literary take on English magic.
